### Completely Trusting Our God of Completion
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-11-2018.html
Passage: Zechariah 9:9
Points:
- Waiting in seasons of painful longing can tempt us to believe God has forgotten His promises.
- Zechariah announced the coming King to weary returned exiles, though the fulfillment arrived centuries later.
- Riding on a donkey rather than a warhorse showed Jesus came for eternal salvation rather than political conquest.
- God's ways often run contrary to human expectations, requiring believers to conform their desires to His plans.
- Even when we cannot see immediate progress, God is faithful to bring His promises to completion.

### Peace to the Nations
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-april-10-2024.html
Passage: Zechariah 9:9-10
Points:
- Jesus entered Jerusalem purposefully to reveal Himself as the promised Messiah-King foretold in Zechariah.
- The crowds desired an earthly political champion to overthrow Rome, misjudging Christ's spiritual mission.
- Instead of riding a war chariot, Jesus came humbly on a donkey to inaugurate universal peace for all nations.
- Believers today risk inventing a self-serving savior suited only for personal comfort and earthly success.
- True worship means honoring Christ for who He truly is rather than forcing Him into our own plans.
